subject: ela
intro: Analyze structural choices and their meaning.

items.prompt:
A resolution that ends in harmony and happiness is:
A) comedic
B) tragic
C) a glossary

A resolution that ends in loss or death is:
A) tragic
B) comedic
C) a stanza

A story's beauty and emotional power is its:
A) aesthetic impact
B) page count
C) margin

An author ends a war novel not with battle but with a soldier planting a garden. This choice:
A) shifts the meaning toward healing and hope
B) glorifies the violence
C) has no effect
items.answer: A) shifts the meaning toward healing and hope

steps: Ending on renewal. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) shifts the meaning toward healing and hope

items.prompt:
A play that could have ended tragically instead ends in reconciliation. This comedic resolution:
A) creates relief and a sense of restored harmony
B) leaves the audience in despair
C) has no effect
items.answer: A) creates relief and a sense of restored harmony

solution.answer: A) creates relief and a sense of restored harmony

items.prompt:
Why does WHERE a story begins matter?
A) it frames the reader's focus and shapes meaning
B) it never matters
C) only the title matters
items.answer: A) it frames the reader's focus and shapes meaning

steps: Starting point shapes focus. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) it frames the reader's focus and shapes meaning

items.prompt:
Two authors tell the same rise-and-fall of a tycoon. One ends at the height of his power; the other at his lonely death. The SECOND ending most likely emphasizes:
A) the emptiness and cost of his ambition
B) that wealth brings joy
C) nothing different
items.answer: A) the emptiness and cost of his ambition

steps: Ending choice shapes meaning. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) the emptiness and cost of his ambition

items.prompt:
An author chooses to end a story on an ambiguous, unresolved note. The MOST likely aesthetic effect is to:
A) leave a haunting impression that invites reflection
B) guarantee a happy feeling
C) remove all meaning
items.answer: A) leave a haunting impression that invites reflection

steps: Open ending = lasting effect. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) leave a haunting impression that invites reflection
